The Community Education Specialist II coordinates educational programming, demonstration agriculture, volunteer engagement, community outreach, and site operations supporting the Living Loop initiative. The position integrates Small Farms, Community Nutrition and Health, Master Gardener, Compost Education, and 4-H programming to deliver hands-on education in healthy food systems, sustainable agriculture, composting, and climate resilience.
Coordinate and conduct Soil-to-Supper school field trips with local schools at Martial Cottle Park Living Loop program educational sites.
